speaker: Copycat
text: Nobody gets past the gate tonight.

speaker: Kachujin
text: Watch me.

speaker: Copycat
text: You're a long way from the city, girl.

speaker: Kachujin
text: And you're a long way from walking away.

speaker: Grey's brute
text: I'll snap you like a twig.

speaker: Kachujin
text: Big talk. Let's see it.

speaker: Copycat
text: Turn back. That Spark belongs to Mr. Grey now.

speaker: Kachujin
text: Then come and take it.

speaker: Kachujin
text: Road's clear. Let's move.

speaker: Kachujin
text: No road. Then I walk.

speaker: Crew
text: We'll have the truck on the far side. Keep that lantern lit.

speaker: Knight
text: A real hero! My shield is yours, Kachujin.

speaker: Knight
text: Shields up! Here they come!

speaker: Barbarian
text: Free! Take my spare axe. Hit them like you mean it.

speaker: Barbarian
text: More of them. Good. I was bored.

speaker: Mage
text: Your blade... let me give it fire. Press V when you need it.

speaker: Mage
text: I feel them in the dark. Careful.

speaker: Ranger
text: Thank you. I never miss. Well. Almost never.

speaker: Ranger
text: Movement ahead. I have them in my sights.

speaker: Rogue
text: I'd have picked that lock myself. Eventually. Thanks.

speaker: Rogue
text: Shh. Something's coming.

speaker: Kachujin
text: Glad to have you. Stay close.

speaker: Kachujin
text: Thanks. Let's make some noise.

speaker: Kachujin
text: Fire. I like it.

speaker: Kachujin
text: Then keep them off my back.

speaker: Kachujin
text: Sure you would. Come on.

speaker: Kachujin
text: Good dog. Let's go.

speaker: Kachujin
text: No... I'm sorry, little one. Rest now.
